snippet.title: War Alert PC version exposes first exposes|Fair Competition·Reignite the Glory of RTS
snippet.description:
Here, we return to the true essence of RTS.  
No overwhelming numbers, only sharp judgment and calm command.  
Every deployment is a decision; every attack and defense, a calculated gamble.  
This is a real battlefield where strategy determines victory.  

War Alert is a fair competitive RTS game for PC, built on UE5. It follows a free-to-play model with paid cosmetics, and emphasizes balanced combat and team coordination. This footage is captured in-engine, containing gameplay demonstrations and cinematic sequences. The game is still in development—what you see does not represent the final quality.  

Pre-registration is now open, along with sign-ups for Operation Mercury – First Test. Test slots are limited—reserve now for your chance to join the fight!
